data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 13.8m (2015: GBP 7.2m) includes a deterioration of GBP 0.7m in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016 were GBP 14.168m. The Syndicate reports a prioryear deterioration of GBP 0.7m included within claims incurred, representing an adverse development (strengthening) of roughly 4.9% of opening gross reserves. The report does not attribute a single named event to this movement, presenting it as portfolio-level adverse claims development within the long-tail legacy business.
raw_causal_phrases: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 13.8m (2015: GBP 7.2m) includes a deterioration of GBP 0.7m in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end.

This increase is driven predominantly by the inclusion of a run-off provision within the Syndicate's technical provisions for the 2016 calendar year following the withdrawal of capital support to underwrite the 2017 year of account.
This movement is the result of claims activity on the 2016 year of account in relation to business written in Latin America.
performance of the legacy European Creditor business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 0.7m) is taken from narrative in Technical Provisions note stating a 'deterioration of GBP 0.7m'. The note does not explicitly label this amount gross vs net; it is presented in the context of gross claims/reserving but some ambiguity exists. Confidence reduced accordingly. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision' table value was present, so the narrative sentence was used.
